name: conductor-swarm
description: Model-agnostic orchestration that discovers available capabilities, activates only what the work needs, and verifies completion.

interface.shortDescription: Route models and skills to verified completion
interface.longDescription: A model-agnostic parent orchestrator that inventories exposed models, skills, tools, and agents; activates the smallest sufficient capability set; resumes existing work through Pickup Swarm; and enforces review, integration, and verification before completion.
defaultPrompt: Inventory my available models and skills, then route this project to completion.
Resume paused workflows and prepare safe sub-agent continuation briefs.
Optimize this plan's token use without cutting tests, review, or quality.
